parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
burden[bə:rdn]n.
A burden is a serious or difficult responsibility.
→ Children who do not behave are a burden to their parents.
😎
compromise[kɑmprəmaiz]v.
To compromise is to agree to something that is not exactly what you want.
→ We both compromised about the game we decided to play.
😎
craft[kræft]v.
To craft something is to make it using skill.
→ She crafted the bookcase out of solid pine wood and then painted it.
😎
crook[kruk]n.
A crook is someone who is not honest or who commits crimes.
→ The manager was arrested by the police for being a crook.
😎
currency[kə:rənsi]n.
Currency is the form of money used in a certain place.
→ Elizabeth had to exchange her dollars for foreign currency.
😎
enigma[inigmə]n.
An enigma is someone or something that is mysterious or hard to understand.
→ The theft of the paintings is an enigma to the investigators.
😎
fragile[frædʒəl]adj.
When people or things are fragile, they are not strong and can be damaged easily.
→ The fragile glassware was carefully packed into boxes.
😎
hybrid[haibrid]n.
A hybrid is a mixture of different things or styles.
→ In Greek mythology, a centaur is a hybrid of a man and a horse.
😎
innocence[inəsns]n.
Innocence is a lack of experience of difficult or complex things in life.
→ Everyone who met her found her innocence to be charming.
😎
merge[mə:rdʒ]v.
To merge two things is to combine them into one whole thing.
→ The storm clouds merged into one large menacing cloud that filled the sky.
😎
moderate[mɑdəreit]adj.
When something is moderate, it is not too big or too small in size or amount.
→ It takes a moderate amount of patience to be around small children all day.
😎
overwhelm[ouvərhwelm]v.
To overwhelm is to exist in such a large amount that someone cannot deal with it.
→ The amount of homework her teacher assigned has overwhelmed her.
😎
perception[pərsepʃən]n.
A perception of a situation is a way of thinking about it or understanding it.
→ Since he couldn't see, his perception of life was much different than mine.
😎
reunion[ri:ju:njən]n.
A reunion is the meeting of people or things that have been separated.
→ Every summer we have a family reunion at the lake.
😎
rig[rig]v.
To rig something means to dishonestly arrange it.
→ The bad politician rigged the election so that he would win.
😎
shiver[ʃivər]n.
A shiver is a shaking movement the body makes when someone is cold or scared.
→ I got shivers on my way home because it was so cold.
😎
sociable[souʃəbl]adj.
When someone is sociable, they are friendly.
→ Many of my good friends are sociable, but I am shy.
😎
talkative[tɔ:kətiv]adj.
When someone is talkative, they talk a lot.
→ My aunt is very talkative whenever she is on the phone.
😎
tow[tou]v.
To tow something is to pull it.
→ The truck was towing a trailer behind it.
😎
tramp[træmp]v.
To tramp is to put your feet down in a loud, heavy way as you walk.
→ The baby tramped across the floor as he was learning to walk.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: If you are an enigma, you are ______.
questions.explanation: enigma là điều bí ẩn (mysterious).

questions.content: If someone is too talkative during a movie, then others may ______.
questions.explanation: Nếu ai đó quá nói nhiều (talkative) trong rạp phim, người khác sẽ nổi giận (get angry).

questions.content: If someone has shivers, what should they do?
questions.explanation: Nếu ai đó bị run lẩy bẩy (shivers) do lạnh, họ nên mặc áo len (Put on a sweater).

questions.content: How should someone deal with another that is overwhelming them?
questions.explanation: Khi bị áp đảo/quá tải (overwhelming), nên nhờ giúp đỡ (Ask for help).

questions.content: Which of the following would have the most innocence?
questions.explanation: Một thiếu niên (A teen) có sự ngây thơ (innocence) nhiều nhất trong số các lựa chọn.

questions.content: What would someone consider a burden?
questions.explanation: Làm hai công việc cùng lúc (Working two jobs) có thể được coi là gánh nặng (a burden).

questions.content: If someone exercised a moderate amount, they would be ______.
questions.explanation: Tập thể dục ở mức vừa phải (moderate) sẽ giúp khỏe mạnh (healthy).

questions.content: Who would you probably see at a reunion?
questions.explanation: Bạn thường gặp gia đình (Your family) ở buổi đoàn tụ (reunion).

questions.content: Where would a crook most likely end up for doing something wrong?
questions.explanation: Kẻ lừa đảo/tội phạm (a crook) thường sẽ phải vào tù (In jail).

questions.content: What is a boat most likely to tow behind it?
questions.explanation: Thuyền thường sẽ kéo (tow) một người lướt ván nước (A water skier) theo sau.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: I met a very <u>friendly</u> girl on my first day of school. [ 11 ]
questions.explanation: friendly (thân thiện) tương đương với sociable.

questions.content: Marty <u>walked heavily</u> across the kitchen to the back door. [ 12 ]
questions.explanation: walked heavily (bước đi nặng nề) tương đương với tramped.

questions.content: That lovely dresser was <u>skillfully made</u> from oak. [ 13 ]
questions.explanation: skillfully made (làm một cách khéo léo) tương đương với crafted.

questions.content: The man had <u>dishonestly changed</u> the game so that he would win every time. [ 14 ]
questions.explanation: dishonestly changed (thay đổi một cách gian lận) tương đương với rigged.

questions.content: The paint colors <u>combined</u> to make new ones on the canvas. [ 15 ]
questions.explanation: combined (kết hợp) tương đương với merged.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Choose the one that is similar in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: fragile
questions.explanation: fragile là mong manh, dễ vỡ (weak).

questions.content: shiver
questions.explanation: shiver là run rẩy (shake).

questions.content: currency
questions.explanation: currency là tiền tệ (money).

questions.content: overwhelm
questions.explanation: overwhelm là áp đảo, làm quá tải (too much).

questions.content: sociable
questions.explanation: sociable là hòa đồng, thân thiện (friendly).

questions.content: craft
questions.explanation: craft là chế tác, làm thủ công (to make).

questions.content: enigma
questions.explanation: enigma là điều bí ẩn (mystery).

questions.content: crook
questions.explanation: crook là kẻ lừa đảo, kẻ trộm (thief).

questions.content: merge
questions.explanation: merge là hòa nhập, kết hợp (to combine).

questions.content: burden
questions.explanation: burden là gánh nặng, trách nhiệm nặng nề (a hard responsibility).

sections.title: Exercise 4: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: Let’s compromise and do exactly what I want.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Compromise là thỏa hiệp (nhượng bộ), không thể là "làm chính xác những gì tôi muốn".

questions.content: Jill’s perception of the movie was opposite to many viewers.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Cách nhìn nhận (perception) về bộ phim.

questions.content: The temperature in here is too moderate. I’m freezing!
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Moderate là vừa phải, ôn hòa. Nếu nhiệt độ ôn hòa thì không thể "chết cóng" (freezing) được.

questions.content: We had a reunion yesterday. I haven’t seen her for years.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Reunion là đoàn tụ (thường dùng cho gia đình/tập thể). Nếu chỉ gặp một người bạn cũ thì thường không dùng reunion.

questions.content: Tonya’s new car is a hybrid that runs on gas and electricity.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Xe lai (hybrid) chạy bằng xăng và điện.

questions.content: It is such burden to drive two hours to work each day.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Lái xe hai giờ mỗi ngày là một gánh nặng (burden).

questions.content: The enigma was so simple that a child could find a solution.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Enigma là điều bí ẩn, khó hiểu. Không thể đơn giản đến mức trẻ con cũng giải được.

questions.content: Her innocence reminded many of us when we were young.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Sự ngây thơ (innocence) của cô bé.

questions.content: I crafted the airplane out of pieces of old wood.
questions.explanation: C (Correct). Tôi chế tạo/lắp ráp (crafted) chiếc máy bay từ gỗ.

questions.content: The snake tramped quietly on its stomach.
questions.explanation: I (Incorrect). Tramp là bước đi nặng nề, ồn ào. Rắn không có chân và trườn nhẹ nhàng nên không thể tramp.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Demon's Bridge

A young woman's cow had crossed the river in the morning when the water level was moderate. But when the woman returned with her dog to get the cow, she was overwhelmed by how high the water had risen. Even if she crossed, she still couldn't tow her cow back through the river.

"What am I going to do?" she wondered.

Suddenly, a man appeared across the river. "A fragile young lady like you shouldn't have to struggle across a river," he said. "I'll build you a bridge."

The man was an enigma. The young woman's perception of him was that he was a sociable person. He was talkative, yet something was strange about him.

"I don't want to be a burden to you, sir," the woman replied.

"Don't worry," he told her as he began crafting a bridge. He merged the pieces of the bridge together with amazing speed. Soon, it was finished.

"Oh, but how can I pay you for your work? Let's compromise. I am sure that we can find a fair solution. What do you think?" The woman asked.

"The only currency I need is the first living thing that crosses the bridge," the man replied.

She thought, "This deal sounds weird. Maybe he's actually a river demon." She shivered because she realized that he had taken advantage of her innocence and rigged the deal somehow. But she had a plan of her own. She pulled a piece of bread from her pocket and threw it across the bridge. Her dog ran after it.

"The dog is the first living thing across the bridge," she said to the man.

The man was angry. He suddenly changed into a hybrid of a human and a fish. "You crook!" he shouted. "You tricked me. I have no use for your dog!" He screamed and dove into the river.

The woman tramped across the bridge to the other side and had a happy reunion with her dog and cow.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false. Rewrite the false statements to make them true.

questions.content: The woman’s perception was that though the man was talkative and sociable, he was also an enigma.
questions.explanation: Đúng nha. Đoạn 4 viết The man was an enigma. The young woman's perception of him was that he was a sociable person. He was talkative, yet something was strange. Cô gái nhận thấy ông ta nói nhiều, hòa đồng nhưng vẫn là một người bí ẩn.

questions.content: When the young woman returned, she was overwhelmed by the moderate water level.
questions.explanation: Sai rồi. Đoạn 1 viết she was overwhelmed by how high the water had risen. Cô ấy bị quá tải (overwhelmed) vì mực nước dâng lên quá cao chứ không phải là mức vừa phải (moderate).

questions.content: The fragile young woman thought she might be a burden to the man.
questions.explanation: Đúng nhé. Trong đoạn 3 và 5, ông ta gọi cô là A fragile young lady, và cô đáp lại I don't want to be a burden to you, sir (Tôi không muốn làm gánh nặng cho ông).

questions.content: While crafting the bridge, the man merged the pieces with amazing speed.
questions.explanation: Đúng rồi. Đoạn 6 miêu tả He merged the pieces of the bridge together with amazing speed. Anh ta đã lắp ráp (merged) các bộ phận của cây cầu với tốc độ đáng kinh ngạc.

questions.content: The woman tramped across the bridge and had a happy reunion with the man.
questions.explanation: Sai nha. Đoạn cuối ghi The woman tramped across the bridge... and had a happy reunion with her dog and cow. Cô bước qua cầu và đoàn tụ (reunion) với chó và bò của mình chứ không phải với người đàn ông.

questions.content: What did the man change into a hybrid of after the dog crossed the bridge?
options: The man turned into a hybrid of a human and a fish.
The man turned into a hybrid of a human and a bird.
The man turned into a hybrid of a bear and a fish.
The man turned into a hybrid of a dog and a fish.
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn 11, tác giả viết He suddenly changed into a hybrid of a human and a fish. Tức là người đàn ông đã biến thành một sinh vật lai (hybrid) giữa người và cá. Chọn đáp án A nhé.

questions.content: Why was the young woman unable to tow her cow across the river?
options: She was overwhelmed by how high the water had risen.
The cow was too heavy to tow.
The river was moving too fast.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 giải thích she was overwhelmed by how high the water had risen. Cô ấy bị choáng ngợp vì mực nước dâng cao nên không thể kéo con bò của mình qua sông. Đáp án A là chính xác.

questions.content: What currency did the man ask to compromise?
options: He asked for the first living thing that crosses the bridge.
He asked for a piece of bread.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 8, ông ta yêu cầu: The only currency I need is the first living thing that crosses the bridge. Loại tiền tệ (currency) duy nhất mà ông ta muốn là sinh vật sống đầu tiên đi qua cây cầu. Chọn đáp án A nha.

questions.content: Why did the young woman shiver?
options: She shivered because she realized that he had taken advantage of her innocence and rigged a trap for her.
She shivered because the water was cold.
She shivered because the demon was scary.
She shivered because the dog ran away.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 9 giải thích She shivered because she realized that he had taken advantage of her innocence and rigged the deal somehow. Cô gái rùng mình vì nhận ra hắn đã lợi dụng sự ngây thơ (innocence) của cô và gài bẫy cô. Mình chọn đáp án A.

questions.content: What did the water demon call the woman just before he dove into the river?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 11 ghi lại tiếng hét của con quỷ nước: "You crook!" he shouted. Tức là hắn gọi cô là một kẻ lừa đảo (crook) trước khi lặn xuống sông. Đáp án đúng là A.
